title: WPA2 Wireless LAN Fundamentals
summary: Design, deploy, and verify a standalone 802.11 wireless local area network using an autonomous access point, WPA2-Personal (Pre-Shared Key with AES encryption), Cisco IOS DHCP services on an edge router, and client host association verification.
learning_objectives: Deploy and configure an autonomous 802.11 wireless access point (AccessPoint-PT) integrated with switched Ethernet infrastructure
Secure the wireless local area network using WPA2-Personal (Pre-Shared Key) and Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) cipher suites
Implement Cisco IOS DHCP address pool services on an upstream default gateway router to lease IPv4 parameters to wireless stations
Equip and configure portable client hosts with 802.11 wireless network interface modules (PT-LAPTOP-NM-1W)
Verify successful 802.11 association, dynamic IP acquisition, and end-to-end IP reachability from wireless stations to wired intranet servers
Test and document negative authentication scenarios demonstrating that incorrect Pre-Shared Keys are blocked from network association

source.origin: Independently authored wireless networking curriculum laboratory aligned with Cisco CCNA exam topic 2.6 (Configure and verify wireless LAN using WPA2 PSK GUI / autonomous architectures) and CCNA 200-301 Section 2.0 (Network Access)
